newsitem.title: USA: ESS Technology changes accounting of merger.
newsitem.headline: ESS Technology changes accounting of merger.

text.p: ESS Technology Inc Tuesday said it would change its recent acquisition of Platform Technologies Inc from a pooling of interests to a purchase, resulting in a one-time charge in the second quarter.
ESS expects to issue 2.54 million shares to shareholders of Platform Technologies.
Its board also authorized the repurchase of up to two million shares of its common stock.
The second quarter charge is for in-process for research and development expenses. It did not specify the amount of the charge.

The repurchase program calls for shares to be purchased in the open market or in private transactions. The repurchased shares will be used to partially offset the shares issued for Platform Technologies, the company said in a press release.

ESS Technology is a supplier of personal computer audio and digital video semiconductor solutions for the PC and consumer markets. ESS designs, develops, and markets highly integrated mixed signal semiconductor and software solutions for multimedia applications.
